triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON public.user_mercenary_cards_v1 REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('user_id', 'collection')

CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_insert_v1 AFTER INSERT ON public.user_mercenary_cards_v1 REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('user_id', 'collection')

CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE ON public.user_mercenary_cards_v1 REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('user_id', 'collection')
CREATE TRIGGER ranked_duo_touch_v1 AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.user_mercenary_cards_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ranked_duo_touch_account_v1()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ranked_duo_touch_account_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN UPDATE ranked_duo_accounts_v1 SET source_version=source_version+1 WHERE user_id=OLD.user_id; ELSE UPDATE ranked_duo_accounts_v1 SET source_version=source_version+1 WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id; IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.user_id<>NEW.user_id THEN UPDATE ranked_duo_accounts_v1 SET source_version=source_version+1 WHERE user_id=OLD.user_id; END IF; END IF; RETURN NULL; END $function$
